arguments.prompt:
Create one standalone logo proposal screen for the personal brand “Jovina Diniz”.

This screen must contain ONLY one logo concept for review.

**LOGO DIRECTION:** Contemporary luxury.
Build a memorable modern luxury logo combining a refined wordmark with one small abstract accent mark. The result should feel current, feminine in a mature way, confident and highly polished, suitable for a premium therapist and mentor brand. Include the descriptor “Terapeuta Integrativa & Mentora de Mulheres”.

**PRESENTATION:** One dominant logo, one compact variant, and one icon-scale accent mark. Label the screen “Opção 08”.

No generic wellness imagery; exclude lotus, butterfly, brain, heart, hands, female silhouette, tree, moon phases, mandala, generic leaf, infinity symbol, medical cross.
